evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Recent large language models can emit task-progress signals that agent frameworks use to decide whether a task should continue or stop, yet whether a model can reliably report its task progress at every stage of a task, and where and how its reports fail, has not been studied systematically.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Most deployed models lose accuracy once work is under way and recover once the task is done.
